name: AutomationDirect 013500-00 enclosure door switch
summary: 013500-00 enclosure door switch arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: 013500-00 is the drawing identifier for enclosure door switch in AutomationDirect's Enclosure Accessories collection. A door switch detects the specified door or access condition. Its mounting and operating alignment need to be coordinated with the moving door and the selected circuit.

For example, in a cabinet using a door-position signal in a documented control circuit, use the 013500-00 reference to coordinate switch fixing, operating contact with the door and conductor route. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/013500-00.DWG, Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/013510-00.DWG, Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/013520-00.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep switch fixing, operating contact with the door and conductor route visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named 013500-00 drawing and its enclosure door switch role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
